title: Find the columns of a table without a partition to look at
prompt: Write columns.sql: a Db2 for i query that lists, for the table ORDHDR in the schema DEVCFC, each column with its name, type, length, scale, whether it accepts a null and its text description, ordered as the table declares them. Use the SQL catalogue in QSYS2, not DSPFFD.
check: test -f columns.sql && codeonly columns.sql | grep -qiE 'QSYS2\.SYSCOLUMNS' && codeonly columns.sql | grep -qiE "TABLE_NAME *= *'ORDHDR'" && codeonly columns.sql | grep -qiE "(TABLE_SCHEMA|SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA) *= *'DEVCFC'" && codeonly columns.sql | grep -qiE 'ORDER +BY +.*ORDINAL_POSITION' && codeonly columns.sql | grep -qiE 'IS_NULLABLE|NULLS'
